_: Ground truth for the R3 sweep (plan step 5's measurement phase). One entry per
candidate of `node scripts/r3-sweep.ts --gamma 200`, keyed by rank in that run's
γ-descending order — regenerate the table and the ranks reproduce, because the
recomputation reproduces all 52 pairs' recorded `matching` blocks.
label: wrong     — the two elements are not the same element; the pair is a matcher defect
correct   — the same element, moved / restyled / reflowed; the findings are true
leafshape — the same REGION on both sides, but the comp's leaf is the impl's several
(or vice versa), so no leaf-to-leaf correspondence exists to be right
how:   pixels — decided by reading each element IN ITS OWN CONTEXT on that side's PNG
(`scripts/r3-crops.ts`), which is the only evidence independent of every
family — decided by pixels on a sibling candidate of identical shape, named in `note`
detail — decided from the strings, the element's own style, and the texts sharing its
line on its own side; NOT from the container column, which is the hypothesis
prior  — established before this sweep (plan step 5's 7 labels), re-checked here
The honest limit: `detail` reads an element's line-mates, and containment reads its
container. Both are 'local surroundings', so a containment rule scored against a
`detail` label is not fully independent of it. The 20 `pixels` labels are; the scoring
below reports the pixels-only subset separately for that reason.
